title: spec: BlueprintViewSchema.name refuses the qualified OBJECT.SUFFIX view name every other view door requires (apply_blueprint answers 'views.0.name must match pattern')
body:
repo:cloud#4 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

Filing gate: finding from the cloud lane (cloud#4339, PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4409, merged). Item 3 of that card; the cloud side now explains the rule, but the root is in spec.

## What
`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` (main ~:418; cloud pin c5758b0d ~:379): `BlueprintViewSchema.name: z.string().regex(SNAKE_CASE)`. An MCP agent sending `views[0].name: 'ticket.open_list'` through `/api/v1/mcp` apply_blueprint gets `views.0.name must match pattern`, while every other view door (and cloud's stager `viewName` in service-ai-studio blueprint-tools.ts) uses or accepts the qualified `OBJECT.SUFFIX` form. Measured through the real door in the cloud PR's test.

## Expected
One rule: either admit `OBJECT.SUFFIX` when the prefix equals the view's `object`, or keep the pattern and say so in `.describe` (so the schema the agent reads states the suffix-only form). Pin test both ways.

Dedupe words: BlueprintViewSchema name SNAKE_CASE qualified view name, apply_blueprint views name pattern. Related: cloud#4339.
